data.name: ThemeDescription
data.value: The theme is applied immediately and saved automatically.

data.name: LanguageDescription
data.value: The interface language is applied immediately and saved automatically.

data.name: MonitoringDescription
data.value: SunTrace compares the system with its latest snapshot and records only detected differences.

data.name: WatchChangesDescription
data.value: Background checks run at the chosen interval while SunTrace is open.

data.name: ScanIntervalDescription
data.value: Does not affect the manual Check button.

data.name: HistoryDepthDescription
data.value: Old snapshots are removed automatically. Events are retained.

data.name: NotifyDescription
data.value: A brief taskbar notification appears when something needs attention.

data.name: StartWithWindowsDescription
data.value: SunTrace opens minimized and continues monitoring in the background.

data.name: LocalHistory
data.value: All history is stored locally in the Windows profile.

data.name: ClearHistoryDescription
data.value: Removes SunTrace snapshots and events. Windows applications and settings are unchanged.

data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: A log of application installations, updates, and changes. No network, telemetry, or registration.

data.name: Privacy
data.value: SunTrace does not collect or send telemetry. All data stays on this computer.
